selected: Correct selection at the provider boundary

semantic_boundary: Executable mark reduction and rule compaction change unused rule outputs. Metadata keeps original relevant guard admission and every live-key reset. Early selection is exact relative to the corrected late provider.

policy.inventory: Global executable catalog only; metadata references never contribute.
policy.live_set: assigned intersect CM-used; recomputed after every compacting executable round.
policy.executable_conditions: Only executable CM outside live is replaced by false.
policy.executable_assignments: Only GEN with live target survives, retaining original action identities.
policy.metadata_conditions: Original relevant-resolution conditions and admission; no new CM specialization.
policy.metadata_actions: Filter effective removal targets by final live keys; preserve carriers whose own mark is unused but which provide a live reset position.
policy.rule_removal: False rows in their own resolved view; actionless source/cleaner effects; empty sinks remain.
policy.unknown_executable_scope: TOP protection or original compatibility view, never empty inferred availability.
policy.alias_reader: Original pass compatibility view; ignored guards do not create executable CM uses.
